_doc: Muc DA DO, DA CAN NHAC, QUYET DINH KHONG SUA. KHAC 'nhieu': nhieu la bo do sai va phai vut bo do di; day la muc co that ma ta chon song chung. diff.mjs khong tinh la loi nhung VAN IN RA moi lan chay, va van canh gac tri so: tut xuong duoi san thi bao do.

muc.lyDo: O nhap bi flex co o dai 1281-1365px (khong con flex-wrap, chua du cho). Chuc nang khong hong: ma co phieu VN dai 3 ky tu, 'FPT'=22px van lot ca o khung hep nhat (vung chu 38px). Chi PHAN GOI Y bi cat, va chi o 1281-1339px — dai rong 59px khong co thiet bi pho bien nao.
